YouTube prank star Jack Tenney of Joogsquad joins Danny Jones for KONCRETE number 6. Forest gives him a grand intro as a world-renowned wild man. Tenney is also brother to famed gamer Tfue.

The group jokes that Tenney serves as his dad's conscience and nemesis. Talk covers pranks, family fame, and life on camera. Tenney explains how stunts built a huge young audience. Jones keeps the tone light and fast. The episode is an early record of Florida's prank scene, told by one of its loudest young names. The family ties add warmth to the pranks.
